We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. Let's hear from each section on what they need so we can put together a plan for the morning coordination board to review.

This means the facilities shop is already committed to the 0800-1000 block for that panel work.
